title: Application crashes after dependency update
briefing: A deployment starts failing immediately after a Python dependency was upgraded.

options.text: Check dependency compatibility and pin compatible package versions

options.why_wrong: The logs show an import error, not resource exhaustion.

options.text: Disable the load balancer health checks
options.why_wrong: Health checks do not resolve incompatible Python packages.
The application fails while importing a dependency.

explanation: The installed Werkzeug version is incompatible with the application's expected API. The application cannot import the requested symbol.
lesson: Review dependency compatibility before upgrades, pin tested versions, and run automated tests before deploying a new release.
hints: Compare the versions of Flask and Werkzeug.
Check compatibility requirements and test a compatible version combination.
